## LangChain

> The most widely used framework for composing LLM applications: chains, retrievers, agents and tools.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Paquet | `langchain-neomundi` 0.2.0 |
| Installation | `pip install 'git+https://github.com/neomundi-io/neomundi-integrations.git#subdirectory=integrations/langchain'` |
| Maturité | beta |
| Niveau de preuve | **E2** — plus real execution against production, proof committed |
| Python | 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 |
| Plateformes | linux, macos, windows |
| Cible vérifiée | `langchain-core` 1.8.5 (bornes 1.0 → <2.0) |
| SDK NeoMundi | ≥ 2.1.0, vérifié 2.1.0 |
| `measurement_version` vérifiée | **3.5.0** |
| Tests hors ligne | 54 |
| Observations réelles | 6, dont 6 relues persistées |
| Facturée | oui |
| Livrée | 2026-11-26 · dernière vérification 2026-11-26 |

**Ce que la technologie garde.** LangChain keeps orchestration, prompting, retrieval and whatever tracing stack you already run.

**Ce que NeoMundi ajoute.** Signed, independently verifiable behavioural measurement of each LLM interaction -- five signals with explicit provenance and an explicit measured / not-measured state -- without writing a measurement call per call site.

**Complète, ne remplace pas :** LangSmith, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry.

**Ce qu'elle refuse de faire.**

- The provider reports no token count, so nothing is submitted and nothing is estimated.
- Your own LLM call failed, so there is no complete interaction to measure.
- The measurement API is unreachable, so the failure is reported and your chain is untouched.
- Sampling excluded the run, so no socket opens and nothing is billed.

🔴 Every submitted observation is a billed measurement; there is no trace-only route. sample_rate defaults to 1.0, so read the cost section before pointing this at a busy application.

## Langfuse

> An open-source LLM observability platform: traces, prompts, cost, sessions, datasets and evaluation scores, self-hosted or in the cloud.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Paquet | `langfuse-neomundi` 0.1.0 |
| Installation | `pip install 'git+https://github.com/neomundi-io/neomundi-integrations.git#subdirectory=integrations/langfuse'` |
| Maturité | experimental |
| Niveau de preuve | **E1** — offline tests, green across platforms |
| Python | 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 |
| Plateformes | linux, macos, windows |
| Cible vérifiée | `langfuse` 5.2.0 (bornes 5.2.0 → <6.0) |
| SDK NeoMundi | ≥ 2.1.0, vérifié 2.1.0 |
| `measurement_version` vérifiée | **3.3.1 (captured fixture, not a live call)** |
| Tests hors ligne | 33 |
| Observations réelles | 0, dont 0 relues persistées |
| Facturée | non |
| Livrée | 2026-11-26 · dernière vérification 2026-11-26 |

**Ce que la technologie garde.** Langfuse keeps the trace: prompt, completion, latency, cost, sessions, datasets, experiments, and the UI the developer already has open.

**Ce que NeoMundi ajoute.** Signed, independently verifiable behavioural measurement of the same interaction, written onto that Langfuse trace as scores -- one per signal the server declared measured -- with the NeoMundi request_id attached so the trace links to the signed record.

**Complète, ne remplace pas :** Langfuse, langchain-neomundi.

**Ce qu'elle refuse de faire.**

- A signal the server did not declare measured gets no numeric score, not even its conventional value.
- There is no Langfuse trace to attach to, so nothing is written.
- A measurement that was not submitted writes only a summary saying so, never a signal.
- A Langfuse or bridge failure is reported as an outcome and never reaches your application.

🔴 The bridge never contacts NeoMundi and bills nothing by itself. The measurement it transports was billed when it was submitted, at 0.030 CHF per observation, by whatever produced it.

## LiteLLM

> An LLM gateway: one OpenAI-style API to 100+ providers, as a Python library or as a proxy server, with routing, retries, budgets and logging callbacks.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Paquet | `litellm-neomundi` 0.1.0 |
| Installation | `pip install 'git+https://github.com/neomundi-io/neomundi-integrations.git#subdirectory=integrations/litellm'` |
| Maturité | beta |
| Niveau de preuve | **E2** — plus real execution against production, proof committed |
| Python | 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 |
| Plateformes | linux, macos, windows |
| Cible vérifiée | `litellm` 1.111.0 (bornes 1.111.0 → <2.0) |
| SDK NeoMundi | ≥ 2.1.0, vérifié 2.1.0 |
| `measurement_version` vérifiée | **3.5.0 (served live, 4 observations re-read)** |
| Tests hors ligne | 47 |
| Observations réelles | 4, dont 4 relues persistées |
| Facturée | oui |
| Livrée | 2026-11-26 · dernière vérification 2026-11-26 |

**Ce que la technologie garde.** LiteLLM keeps routing, retries, fallbacks, budgets, virtual keys, its cost table and whatever logging callbacks you already run.

**Ce que NeoMundi ajoute.** Signed, independently verifiable behavioural measurement of every chat completion the gateway routes, to any provider, from one attachment point -- with the latency LiteLLM observed, and only token counts the provider itself published.

**Complète, ne remplace pas :** LiteLLM logging callbacks, Langfuse, langchain-neomundi.

**Ce qu'elle refuse de faire.**

- The provider published no token count; LiteLLM's zero or estimate is refused, never forwarded.
- An async stream hides the provider's payload from the logger, so it is refused rather than trusted.
- A cache hit, a failed call or a non-chat call is not a model interaction to measure.
- The measurement API is unreachable, so the failure is reported and your call is untouched.

🔴 Every submitted observation is a billed measurement; there is no trace-only route. sample_rate defaults to 1.0 and a gateway sees every call -- start with submit=False, which needs no key and opens no socket.

## MLflow

> The tracing layer of MLflow, built on OpenTelemetry: autolog instrumentations for model clients and agent frameworks record each call as a span in a trace, stored next to the experiments and runs MLflow users already compare.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Paquet | `mlflow-neomundi` 0.1.0 |
| Installation | `pip install 'git+https://github.com/neomundi-io/neomundi-integrations.git#subdirectory=integrations/mlflow'` |
| Maturité | beta |
| Niveau de preuve | **E2** — plus real execution against production, proof committed |
| Python | 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 |
| Plateformes | linux, macos, windows |
| Cible vérifiée | `mlflow-tracing` 3.18.0 (bornes 3.18.0 → <3.19) |
| SDK NeoMundi | ≥ 2.1.0, vérifié 2.1.0 |
| `measurement_version` vérifiée | **3.5.0 (served live, 4 observations re-read)** |
| Tests hors ligne | 75 |
| Observations réelles | 4, dont 4 relues persistées |
| Facturée | oui |
| Livrée | 2026-11-26 · dernière vérification 2026-11-26 |

**Ce que la technologie garde.** MLflow keeps its autolog instrumentation, the traces, the tracking store, the UI, experiments and run comparison. The integration appends one function to MLflow's own span processors and replaces nothing.

**Ce que NeoMundi ajoute.** Signed, independently verifiable behavioural measurement of each model call MLflow traced, with the provider's own token count and the latency MLflow recorded -- and the NeoMundi request_id and measurement version written back on the MLflow trace, next to the run you compare.

**Complète, ne remplace pas :** MLflow Tracing and its autolog integrations, the MLflow UI, experiments and evaluation, otel-neomundi, openai-agents-neomundi, langchain-neomundi.

**Ce qu'elle refuse de faire.**

- A count written by anything but MLflow's openai autolog -- the Agents SDK tracer's zero fill, LiteLLM's estimate, LangChain's usage_metadata, a hand-written span -- is never submitted.
- No provider usage, a partial one or a zero total; never estimated, never rebuilt.
- Agent, chain, workflow and task spans are sums of calls already measured; tools, retrievers and embeddings are not model calls.
- The measurement API is unreachable, so the failure is reported and your call is untouched.

🔴 Every submitted observation is a billed measurement; there is no trace-only route. One observation per measured model call; aggregate spans are never billed. Start with submit=False, which needs no key and opens no socket.

## OpenAI Agents SDK

> OpenAI's framework for agentic applications: agents with tools, handoffs, guardrails and sessions, run in a loop by a Runner, with built-in tracing and pluggable trace processors.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Paquet | `openai-agents-neomundi` 0.1.0 |
| Installation | `pip install 'git+https://github.com/neomundi-io/neomundi-integrations.git#subdirectory=integrations/openai-agents'` |
| Maturité | beta |
| Niveau de preuve | **E2** — plus real execution against production, proof committed |
| Python | 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 |
| Plateformes | linux, macos, windows |
| Cible vérifiée | `openai-agents` 0.26.0 (bornes 0.26.0 → <0.27) |
| SDK NeoMundi | ≥ 2.1.0, vérifié 2.1.0 |
| `measurement_version` vérifiée | **3.5.0 (served live, 4 observations re-read)** |
| Tests hors ligne | 45 |
| Observations réelles | 4, dont 4 relues persistées |
| Facturée | oui |
| Livrée | 2026-11-26 · dernière vérification 2026-11-26 |

**Ce que la technologie garde.** The Agents SDK keeps the agent loop, tools, handoffs, guardrails and its tracing -- including its own exporter to the OpenAI dashboard and any processor you registered. The processor is appended and evicts nobody.

**Ce que NeoMundi ajoute.** Signed, independently verifiable behavioural measurement of every model call the agent loop makes -- the call that decides on a tool and the one that reads its result -- with the provider's own token count and the latency the SDK recorded, each outcome naming the agent and the tools it requested.

**Complète, ne remplace pas :** the Agents SDK's tracing and the OpenAI traces dashboard, litellm-neomundi, langchain-neomundi, otel-neomundi.

**Ce qu'elle refuse de faire.**

- A Chat Completions or LiteLLM generation span is never submitted; its usage is zero-filled, or a local estimate, and cannot be traced to the provider.
- Turn and task spans are sums of calls already measured; tool executions and agent steps are not model calls.
- No provider usage, a partial one, a run without sensitive data, or AnyLLMModel loaded -- the count's origin cannot be established.
- The measurement API is unreachable, so the failure is reported and your agent run is untouched.

🔴 Every submitted observation is a billed measurement; there is no trace-only route. An agent run is billed once per model call, so a tool-using run costs several observations. Start with submit=False, which needs no key and opens no socket.

## OpenTelemetry

> The vendor-neutral tracing standard. Instrumentations for model clients (contrib openai-v2, OpenLLMetry and others) emit GenAI spans that the application exports to the backend it already runs.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Paquet | `otel-neomundi` 0.1.0 |
| Installation | `pip install 'git+https://github.com/neomundi-io/neomundi-integrations.git#subdirectory=integrations/otel'` |
| Maturité | beta |
| Niveau de preuve | **E2** — plus real execution against production, proof committed |
| Python | 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 |
| Plateformes | linux, macos, windows |
| Cible vérifiée | `opentelemetry-sdk` 1.45.2 (bornes 1.45.2 → <2.0) |
| SDK NeoMundi | ≥ 2.1.0, vérifié 2.1.0 |
| `measurement_version` vérifiée | **3.5.0 (E2, 2026-11-26)** |
| Tests hors ligne | 48 |
| Observations réelles | 4, dont 4 relues persistées |
| Facturée | oui |
| Livrée | 2026-11-26 · dernière vérification 2026-11-26 |

**Ce que la technologie garde.** OpenTelemetry keeps the instrumentation, the pipeline, the exporters, the sampling and the tracing backend you already run. The processor is added next to your exporters and replaces nothing.

**Ce que NeoMundi ajoute.** Signed, independently verifiable behavioural measurement of a model call you already trace, using the latency the trace observed -- and the NeoMundi request_id written into the same trace. It never turns a span's token count into a measurement: a span cannot prove where that count came from.

**Complète, ne remplace pas :** OpenTelemetry GenAI instrumentations (contrib openai-v2, OpenLLMetry), your tracing backend (Jaeger, Tempo, Honeycomb, Datadog...), litellm-neomundi, langchain-neomundi.

**Ce qu'elle refuse de faire.**

- A token count read from a span is never submitted; only the count the caller declares from its provider's response.
- No GenAI span, or more than one, inside an interaction -- which call is meant is not guessed.
- A failed model call, or an exception in the application's block, is not measured.
- The measurement API is unreachable, so the failure is reported and your call is untouched.

🔴 Every submitted observation is a billed measurement; there is no trace-only route. Nothing is billed for a span alone: only an interaction with a declared count is submitted. Start with submit=False, which needs no key and opens no socket.
